messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: PagerRelay outgoing pipeline returned 202 but no escalation metadata assigned. Paging suppressed for ~12m. incident_id=PR-87654
jake_oncall: saw this, I didn't receive a page. Is there a suppressed window visible somewhere?
micah: checking logs now, provider returned 200 but response body empty. looks like header strip on relay. logs:
```
2026-03-17T05:42:11Z INFO outgoing: POST /pg/send 200 - body:'' x-pager-id:abc123
2026-03-17T05:42:11Z WARN router: no-escalation-meta for abc123
```
micah: suspect recent signing rotation removed x-escalation headers in proxy rewrite
natalie: @ops-bot can you re-run the send with debug headers so we can see what's cleared? we've got customer impact on 2 tenants
ops-bot: Debug re-send initiated by @natalie. (automation)
jake_oncall: manual SMS + voice fallback triggered for tenants alpha & beta :phone: manual notes: used SMS gateway fallback and alerted CS
sara: thanks — CS is being looped in. Any idea why incidentbot didn't escalate to the paging channel itself?
micah: incidentbot consumed the webhook fine but the pipeline filter checks for x-escalation; when header missing, suppressor nails it (intended behavior). header got stripped earlier in the proxy rewrite path
lex: quick mitigation plan: re-enable header pass-through on the proxy for webhook route, then roll to prod with 1-min canary
natalie: rolling patch to proxy now, pushing canary to 1/3 hosts
micah: patch applied to canary host, re-triggering the previously failed webhook via test harness
ops-bot: test webhook result: 200 + x-escalation header present -> page delivered to oncall channel
jake_oncall: confirmed receipt of pages and SMS. manual handoff completed and alerts acknowledged
sara: customer impact summary: two tenants missed alerts for ~12 minutes. CS notified and working with impacted customers; monitoring closely
micah: root cause: signing rotation cleanup unintentionally removed non-standard headers when proxy did a header canonicalize step
lex: follow-ups: 1) revert header canonicalization for webhook route 2) add header-preserve rule in proxy config 3) add unit/integration test to assert escalation header presence in pipeline
natalie: filing incident ticket PR-87654 and scheduling RCA sync tomorrow 10:30 PT
jake_oncall: thanks all. I'll keep the manual fallback docs updated. Closing once CS confirms customer containment and RCA ticket exists :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PR-87654
sara: adding postmortem template & owner @micah to the Jira ticket
micah: I'll own the RCA and the fix, will post draft before the sync
